what: The number chips and tag strips flow left on their own — the speed is screen width × .4 clamped to 20–40px/s (40px/s on both wide screens and phones). Hovering over a strip slows it to .3x, and on leave it returns to its own speed, easing frame by frame by 8% of the remaining gap so it slows down and recovers smoothly. Strip content is cloned enough to fill the screen and loops endlessly.
ease: none · speed follows at 8% per frame

options.speed: Per-second ratio multiplied by screen width, default .4
options.slow: Scale on hover, default .3 — 0 stops it

from.where: index.html·list.html tilted number chip band (.b-band) — original rotating-words-banner marquee
